newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Investors keep the faith in Belgian Bel-20.
newsitem.headline: Investors keep the faith in Belgian Bel-20.

text.p: The Bel-20 share index, up nearly one percent on Tuesday on a strong performance by Wall Street, the dollar and bonds, shrugged off increasing volatility in Belgian shares and nervousness over U.S. March CPI data, dealers said.

At 0835 GMT, the Bel-20 was up 0.95 percent, or 19.89 points, at 2,116.23. Dealers said investors were not inclined to sell. "On the contrary, those who show up want to buy more," said Patricia Decolvenaer at De Maertelaere.
But volume was a paltry 420 million francs and was unlikely to grow much before the CPI data at 1230 GMT US-ECI.
"Belgians still tend to think that (the index) should be sky-high," Decolvenaer said.
She said the Bel-20's gains were likely to be pared before the data which might fuel U.S. rate hike worries.
Decolvenaer said that business was almost exclusively professional. "Institutionals are not in the market."
Dollar-sensitive oil firm Petrofina was the main gainer with a 2.1 percent rise to 12,250.
Chemicals and pharmaceuticals firm UCB rose 0.6 percent to 89,800. Both UCB and holding firm GBL got a 'hold' advice from Generale Bank in its daily market focus.
